final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 THEN 1 END) > 0), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM sex_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_ratio FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_ratio > m.mean_ratio), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM first_kept) SELECT AVG(f.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(f.avg_ratio - m1.mean_ratio) AS above_first_mean, AVG(f.avg_ratio - m2.mean_ratio) AS above_second_mean FROM first_kept AS f CROSS JOIN first_mean AS m1 CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m2 WHERE f.avg_ratio > m2.mean_ratio
